title: Cloud Security: log retention
content:
Cloud Security uses the following tier-specific bases for log retention.

## Basis

Included searchable retention days: Included searchable log retention; calendar days integer.

Archive storage rate: Archived security log storage; USD per GB-month.

Archive retrieval rate: Archived log retrieval; USD per GB.

## Tier values

| Security tier | Included searchable retention days | Archive storage rate | Archive retrieval rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Cloud Security 50 Workloads | 30 | 0.031 | 0.015 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 100 Workloads | 30 | 0.031 | 0.015 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 250 Workloads | 30 | 0.031 | 0.015 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 500 Workloads | 30 | 0.031 | 0.015 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 1000 Workloads | 30 | 0.031 | 0.015 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 2500 Workloads | 30 | 0.031 | 0.015 |

## Tier comparison

The listed log retention bases are the same across these six Security tiers.
